# BrandLinker

> BrandLinker (https://www.brandlinkerbd.com/) is a venture and brand headquarters founded by RS Lina in Dhaka, Bangladesh. Slogan: Brands Connect Opportunities. It runs brands across travel, Dubai property, travel commerce and safe mobility.

## Brands
- [Cheap Ticket Finder](https://cheapticketfinder.site/): Cheap flight search for travellers in Bangladesh
- [BrandLinker Dubai](https://brandlinkerdubai.com/): Dubai off-plan property explained in Bangla and English
- [BrandLinker Spark](https://www.brandlinkerspark.com/): Travel gear: adapters, power banks, luggage scales
- [SheRides](https://sherides.online/): Women-only ride sharing in Bangladesh
